operator_reported_failure.boundary: Exit code, elapsed time and empty output are operator-supplied observations. This source-only review does not claim to reconstruct the exact command line or effective environment after the fact.

mechanical_diagnosis.exit_6_predicate: M518_EXPECTED_STATIC_ADMISSION_SHA256 must match exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
mechanical_diagnosis.conclusion: Given the reported exit code, control stopped at the admission-SHA format gate before mkdir. The on-disk SHA and regex are valid, so the effective process value read from the exact M518_EXPECTED_STATIC_ADMISSION_SHA256 name was absent, malformed, or carried extra text/whitespace. The surviving evidence cannot distinguish those launch-plumbing cases and does not prove a particular typo.

tool_and_artifact_boundary.reason: All negative-control and EDA commands occur after canonical mkdir, while reported exit 6 occurs at the sole line-17 gate before mkdir.

P1.finding: The one-shot launch did not preserve the effective argv/environment, and the bare gate emits no diagnostic.
P1.impact: The exact absent-versus-extra-text-versus-wrong-name cause cannot be distinguished after the failure; another hand-entered r10 retry would also violate the one-invocation admission.

unique_minimal_repair.reason_r10_retry_forbidden: The double-sealed r10 admission authorizes exactly one runner invocation, not one VCS invocation. The reported r10 runner invocation consumed it even though it stopped before EDA.
runner_only_change: Use a new r11 canonical result identity and a new independently reviewed, double-sealed one-shot r11 admission.
Before any result mkdir, distinguish unset from malformed M518_EXPECTED_STATIC_ADMISSION_SHA256 and emit only a non-secret diagnostic containing presence and length, never the value.
Require presence, exact length 64, lowercase-hex regex, live file SHA equality, both admission seals, and strict admission semantics before mkdir.
Reject bool for authorized_invocations and require JSON integer 1.

Provide and independently SHA-review one immutable r11 launch wrapper or command file that sets both exact SHA variable names and unsets M518_RUN_DIR; the operator must execute that artifact instead of retyping assignments.
authorization_conditions: A new author request freezes the r11 runner, wrapper/command file, contract and result identity while preserving candidate source hashes above.
A different source-only reviewer validates every pre-tool gate, the wrapper's effective environment, canonical absence, and all member/outer seals.
Root creates a new exact-SHA, double-sealed r11 admission for one invocation only after that review.
Only then may exactly one r11 wrapper invocation run its negative control, one Full64 VCS identity query, one Full64 VCS compile and one fixed-seed simv.
A different receipt reviewer must seal the completed result before any runtime claim.
